payment.title: Pay ₹{amount} by UPI
payment.subtitle: Pay from any UPI app (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM) within 10 minutes, then upload the payment screenshot — your ticket is issued as soon as it's checked.
payment.uploadHint: Screenshot of the “Payment successful” screen showing amount, date & time, receiver and transaction ID
payment.utrHint: We read it from the screenshot automatically — type it only if you have it handy.
payment.submittedBanner: 🙏 Payment screenshot received — your ticket below is your receipt. The temple office will verify the payment.
payment.rejectedNote: Your earlier payment screenshot couldn't be verified: {note} Please pay and upload again, or pay at the temple counter.

errors.bad_file: Please choose a photo or screenshot (JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to 10 MB).
errors.failed: Couldn't upload. Check your connection and try again.
errors.not_found: Booking not found. Please open your ticket again.
errors.read_failed: We couldn't read the screenshot just now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.duplicate_utr: Invalid payment details — this transaction has already been used for another booking.

payment.windowRule: Pay the exact amount within this window. Payments made before the QR was shown or after it expires can't be accepted.
payment.expiredBodyBooking: Already paid? Upload the screenshot from your ticket or My bookings. Not paid yet? Show the QR again and pay within 10 minutes.
payment.expiredBodyTicket: Already paid? Upload the screenshot below. Not paid yet? Show the QR again and pay within 10 minutes.
payment.uploadMoved: The QR window has closed. Upload your payment screenshot from your ticket — your seat stays reserved and you can download the ticket there.

invalid.not_payment: This isn't a UPI payment screenshot. Please upload the screenshot of the “Payment successful” screen.
invalid.not_successful: The screenshot doesn't show a successful payment. If money was deducted, wait for it to complete and upload the final screen.
invalid.wrong_receiver: This payment wasn't made to the temple's UPI account. The screenshot must show the temple's name, UPI ID or number as the receiver.
invalid.amount_mismatch: The screenshot shows ₹{paid}, but your tickets total ₹{expected}. Please pay the exact total, or contact the temple office.
invalid.missing_time: The screenshot must show the payment date and time.
invalid.date_mismatch: The payment date ({date}) doesn't match the day the payment QR was shown.
invalid.time_mismatch: The payment time ({time}) is outside the QR's 10-minute window ({from}–{to}). Show the QR again, pay within the window, and upload that screenshot.
invalid.other_booking: The payment note belongs to a different booking.
invalid.utr_mismatch: The transaction ID you typed doesn't match the screenshot.
invalid.missing_utr: The transaction ID (UTR) isn't visible. Upload a screenshot that shows it, or type it in the box above.
